hero.title: Integral University, Lucknow
hero.summary: Integral’s agriculture institute in Lucknow combines a four-year bachelor’s degree with farm units for crop practicals, organic production, mushrooms, weather observation and integrated farming. Students study agriculture within a dedicated institute whose teaching setting includes vegetable, flower and orchard work alongside the scientific curriculum.

overview.heading: A network of teaching farms at IIAST
paragraphs: Integral’s agriculture institute was founded in 2014, according to its own farm information page. Its teaching context combines crop production with applied work across several farm units. These include plots for vegetables and flowers, organic farming activity and units that demonstrate links between farm resources.

The institute’s teaching units extend from crop plots to orchard, processing and integrated-farming activity. These settings allow different agricultural subjects to be considered together: soils influence crops, weather informs production decisions, and farm products enter processing and markets. The programme page describes a four-year B.Sc. Agriculture route with science or agriculture entry combinations, while the university’s admissions criteria identify IUET for the 2026 session.

faqs.question: What is IIAST at Integral University?
faqs.answer: It is the Integral Institute of Agricultural Science and Technology, which organises the university’s agriculture teaching.

faqs.question: Which degree is covered by this ICAR entry?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, for 26 September 2024 to 25 September 2029.

faqs.question: How long does Integral list the bachelor’s degree?
faqs.answer: The institute programme page lists four years.

faqs.question: What makes the farm setting distinctive?
faqs.answer: Separate units document activities including mushrooms, weather observation, organic production and integrated farming.

faqs.question: Is IUET relevant to agriculture applicants?
faqs.answer: The university’s 2026 admission criteria identify IUET for its programmes apart from specified professional exceptions. Confirm the B.Sc. instructions before applying.

faqs.question: Are agriculture placement figures verified?
faqs.answer: No. A dated training event was found, but a cohort-based agriculture outcome report was not.

faqs.question: What agriculture fee amount has Integral published?
faqs.answer: The official Indian-applicant table lists ₹70,000 per year for B.Sc. Agriculture. Its academic year is unstated, so this is not verified as a current 2026–27 or 2027 quote; obtain a dated itemised statement.
